interpretation: The relaxed min1/cap100 initial prefilter changes downstream group and pair populations substantially, including many additions despite fewer total predicted pairs. Small GO/EC mean increases occur with changed eligible populations and original denominators; shared pairs have identical serialized annotation scores. These conditional functional means are not evidence of improved annotation similarity on the same pairs or unconditional orthology accuracy. The independently admitted primary F1 declines and failed full-vector development screen remain unchanged; do not promote this default.
limits: Post hoc development diagnostics; no independent confirmation or uncertainty interval.
Group/pair turnover does not establish which changed relations are correct or uniquely locate a causal stage.
Different serialized tree bytes do not establish different topology or phylogeny as the cause.
High/medium native confidence labels are reconciliation evidence categories, not calibrated correctness probabilities.
FAS remains unseeded and is excluded from this decomposition; exported relation count is not the sampled/scored FAS denominator.
Raw serialized mean differences can differ slightly from differences of eight-decimal aggregate scores; no benchmark score is replaced.
One-CPU diagnostic times and process-RSS values are descriptive and not native pipeline timing or isolated speed comparisons.
